chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: Dances and ballrooms like the Indiana Roof with Speed Webb
summary: Bands played dances rather than concerts, sometimes in ballrooms like the Indiana Roof, where Speed Webb's jumping band played a few weeks.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What kind of hours would you play then? Would it be mostly...
Oh, I wouldn't know. I just don't remember.
And not clubs either. I guess ballrooms primarily?

Sometimes ballrooms. Well, there would be ballrooms that you'd play in anyhow, that somebody would rent it for the night. There were some ballrooms, like the Indiana Roof, that ran every night. When I was with Speed Webb we played there for about two or three weeks; I don't know exactly how long.
Did you play opposite another band?
I don't know. I don't remember. I don't think we played opposite anybody. We had a real jumpin' band.
Yeah, that must have been some band.
